title: ActorAssignment
description: actor.assignment@1: one node of the tree of delegated work (plan §12). A node is a hand-off — a person giving Actor a task, a routine or Watch trigger starting a run, an agent handing work to another agent, or Actor starting a Codes or Space task. ID is the node; ROOT names the node whose BUDGET the whole tree spends, PARENT the node that handed this work over (null on a root) and DEPTH its distance from the root (0 on a root). ORIGIN says who started the line: a person (person), a routine or Watch trigger (routine), or work from outside Actor (outside). MODE is the hand-off's kind (work, consult, notify) and REPLY how its result comes back (resume into the parent, poll, or none). LEVEL is the node's own level and EFFECTIVE_LEVEL the level its steps run at: the higher of the agent's own level and the one inherited from a person's or routine's line. Outside work never passes a level down. BUDGET is the root's budget and what the tree has spent. A cancel cascades down the tree. GET /api/v1/assignments/:id returns { assignment, children } and POST /api/v1/assignments/:id/cancel returns { assignment, cancelled }; both are owner-only, and another person's node is the same 404 as one that does not exist. A task has no node until one is made for it: an existing task gets a root lazily.

budget.description: The budget of the root of this tree, and what the tree has spent of it. Every node carries the same root budget.
